name: Uzziah
overview: Uzziah, also known as Azariah, was a king of Judah whose reign is notably recorded during the prophetic ministries of Isaiah and Amos, highlighting a significant period in Judah's history (Isaiah 1:1; Amos 1:1). Scripture identifies him as a descendant of Uriel and the father of Jehonathan and Athaiah, linking him to key priestly and royal lineages (1 Chronicles 6:24; 1 Chronicles 27:25; Nehemiah 11:4). His era was marked by both prosperity and judgment, as indicated by the historical record of an earthquake and his eventual affliction, underscoring God's sovereign hand over the nation.
